description: PSQ-2 v1: LoRA fine-tune Qwen3-1.7B-Base on single-step two-dial transitions, then test multi-step generalization. Tests whether learned single-step dynamics induce multi-step latent geometry.
scientific_question: Does single-step LoRA fine-tuning induce multi-step compositional generalization? If the model learns A,B,C,D individually, can it compose them in sequences it never trained on?
success_criterion: >=95% per-cell accuracy on 2-8 step sequences (never seen during training)
fallback: If single-step training fails: psq2_v2 with 1-3 step training, test on 4-8 step
